deal.description: Residential HVAC and plumbing contractor serving Greater Hamilton, Ontario since 1998. 36 employees (22 licensed field technicians), 24 service vans and a 2,900-member Comfort Club maintenance plan (about $910K recurring revenue). FY2024 revenue $7.41M, SDE $1.31M. Owner retiring; share sale preferred.

overview.reason: Reputation drives referrals and repeat business in residential trades.

employees.reason: Licensed technicians are scarce; retention risk kills deal value.

strengths.reason: Differentiators matter in competitive HVAC and plumbing markets.

financials.reason: SDE and working capital needs determine affordability and returns.

operations.reason: Dispatch systems and service processes determine scalability and efficiency.

real_estate.reason: Shop location and lease terms affect fleet operations and overhead.

seasonality.reason: HVAC has extreme seasonal swings affecting cash flow and staffing.

asking_price.reason: Price and terms must align with SBA lending limits.

buyer_profile.reason: Most buyers already know if they fit this business.

target_market.reason: Geographic service area and customer demographics define addressable market.

reason_for_sale.reason: Buyers fear hidden problems in owner-dependent service businesses.

revenue_sources.reason: Service versus install mix drives margin and recurring revenue stability.

growth_potential.reason: Buyers focus on current cash flow over future opportunities.

permits_licenses.reason: Ontario HVAC and plumbing licenses are hard to transfer.

training_support.reason: Owner relationships with suppliers and customers need smooth handoff.
